Application Data.NAME: Sunrise Hospitality Group
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Sunrise Hospitality Group operates a chain of upscale hotels and boutique accommodations, offering guests a unique blend of luxury and comfort. Our properties provide a wide range of amenities including spacious guest rooms, fine dining restaurants, meeting and event spaces, and recreational facilities. We prioritize exceptional customer service and aim to create memorable experiences for our guests, catering to both leisure and business travelers. Each location is strategically positioned to attract a diverse clientele while ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards.
